claims.text: The Legislative Assembly's article of 19 November 2019 states that 'Akilisi Pohiva, former Member of Parliament for Tongatapu 1 and late Prime Minister, passed away in September of that year.
claims.uncertainty: Death at month precision only; the day is not given. The article concerns a parliamentary seat to be filled, not a party-leadership vacancy, and states no party succession. It is not used as the end of any office term in this packet.

claims.text: The same article states that the Tongatapu 1 by-election to fill his seat is to be held on Thursday 28 November 2019, with two candidates: number one Siaosi Pohiva and number two Dr. Netatua Pelesikoti Taufatofua.

claims.uncertainty: An advance notice dated by its creation date: it does not record that the poll took place or its result. A seat vacancy is not a party office.
